content.title: Trump's furniture tariffs hit importers in latest trade salvo
content.summary: (Reuters) -Shares of U.S.-based furniture companies that rely on imports slipped on Friday as President Donald Trump's latest tariff salvo targeted couches and cabinets and analysts reiterated warnings about the longer-term effects of likely price rises.  Trump announced a 50% tariff on imported kitchen cabinets and vanities, along with a 30% levy on upholstered furniture, which are set to take effect on October 1.  Initially, companies that produce domestically like La-Z-Boy and Ethan Allen jumped on the news.
